label: Seated Pose
description: Chair, stool and floor seating mechanics for portrait work — the seated counterpart of pose/standing.

items.name: stool-lean-in
items.text: perched on a stool, elbows planted on the knees, torso pitched toward the lens

items.name: chair-reverse-straddle
items.text: straddling a reversed chair, forearms stacked on the backrest, chin resting on them

items.name: crossed-knee-poise
items.text: seated tall with legs crossed at the knee, hands stacked on the top knee, shoulders level

items.name: floor-editorial
items.text: seated on the floor, one leg extended, the other knee raised, leaning back on a straight arm

items.name: perch-edge
items.text: perched on the front edge of the seat, spine long, ankles crossed beneath the chair

items.name: armchair-sprawl
items.text: settled deep into an armchair, one arm draped along the armrest, ankle resting on the opposite knee
